Part 1—Preliminary
1-1 Name
This instrument is the synthetic test version of the Rules, used only by the parser tests.
1-4 Definitions
In this instrument, beneficial owner has the meaning given by the Act, and politically exposed person
has the meaning given by the Act.
Authorised Version F2099C00001 registered 31/03/2026

Customer due diligence Part 6
Initial customer due diligence Division 1
Section 6-1
Synthetic Test Rules 2025 2
Compilation No. 1 Compilation date: 31/03/2026
Part 6—Customer due diligence
Division 1—Initial customer due diligence
6-1 Customer is sole trader
(1) The reporting entity must collect at least the following KYC information:
(a) the customer's full name;
(b) any business name used for the conduct of the business;
(c) the address of the principal place of business.
6-2 Customer is body corporate, partnership or unincorporated association
(1) The reporting entity must collect at least the following KYC information:
(a) the customer's full name;
(b) any business names of the customer;
Authorised Version F2099C00001 registered 31/03/2026

Part 6 Customer due diligence
Division 1 Initial customer due diligence
Section 6-2
3 Synthetic Test Rules 2025
Compilation No. 1 Compilation date: 31/03/2026
(c) evidence of the customer's existence.
6-9 The nature and purpose of the business relationship or occasional
transaction
For the purposes of the Act, a reporting entity is taken to have established the matter if:
(a) the customer's full name has been collected; and
(b) the reporting entity has identified the ML/TF risk of the customer.
Division 3—Simplified customer due diligence
6-18 Simplified initial customer due diligence for identity of beneficial owners
(1) A reporting entity is taken to have established the beneficial owners of a customer if the customer is
subject to oversight by a prudential regulator.
Note: (a) the customer's full name; appears here as a repeated body line and must not be stripped.
